title: testmap select leaves out a test that scans every _tools file as text, so a new tool file turns main red unseen
goal: testmap.py select adds every test that reads the _tools source files as text (TestRemoteRoles in test_kbpublic.py, the leak and cohesion scans) for a change to any _tools/*.py, with a test named testmap_selects_source_scans that plants a tool file naming a forbidden string and sees the scan selected. Found when autopilot.py named the remote literally: tests.py --changed ran 13 of 52 test files, missed test_kbpublic.py, and main went red.
